data.title: TDS URL Parameter Fingerprint Tracking Across Rotating Domains
data.description: Detects consistent URL query parameter patterns (TDS software behavioral signatures) appearing across multiple rotating domains, indicating a single TDS operator managing infrastructure through domain rotation. TDS operators require consistent parameter schemas to route traffic between affiliates, track conversions, and attribute payouts — these parameters are the TDS internal API contract visible in redirect URLs even when domain names rotate. The VexTrio TDS was tracked for years via its distinctive ?u=&o= query parameter format before corporate attribution was achieved (Black Hat USA 2025, Infoblox). This rule identifies recurring parameter fingerprints across newly registered or rapidly rotating domains as indicators of TDS infrastructure managed by a single operator.

queries.splunk:
`comment("Splunk SPL for TDS URL Parameter Fingerprint Tracking")`
`comment("Identifies consistent TDS parameter patterns across rotating domains")`
index=flame_proxy sourcetype=flame:http_log http_status IN (301, 302, 307)
(url_query="*?u=*&o=*" OR url_query="*aff_id=*&click_id=*" OR url_query="*subid=*&source=*&clickid=*" OR url_query="*pid=*&offer_id=*")
| rex field=url_query "(?<param_pattern>[a-z_]+=)[^&]*(&[a-z_]+=)[^&]*"
| eval param_fingerprint=param_pattern
| lookup domain_age_feed dest_domain OUTPUT domain_age_days
| where domain_age_days < 90 OR isnull(domain_age_days)
| stats dc(dest_domain) AS unique_domains
        values(dest_domain) AS domains
        dc(src_ip) AS unique_visitors
        count AS total_hits
        earliest(_time) AS first_seen
        latest(_time) AS last_seen
    by param_fingerprint
| where unique_domains >= 3
| sort -unique_domains
queries.cql:
// CrowdStrike CQL for TDS URL Parameter Fingerprint Tracking
// Repository: flame-proxy-http-log
http_status=/30[127]/
| url_query=/\?(u=[^&]*&o=|aff_id=[^&]*&click_id=|subid=[^&]*&source=[^&]*&clickid=|pid=[^&]*&offer_id=)/
| regex("(?<param_fingerprint>[a-z_]+=)[^&]*(&[a-z_]+=)", field=url_query)
| groupBy([param_fingerprint], function=[
    count(as=total_hits),
    collectDistinct(dest_domain, as=unique_domains),
    collectDistinct(src_ip, as=unique_visitors)
  ])
| length(unique_domains) >= 3

falsepositives: Legitimate affiliate marketing campaigns using consistent tracking parameters across multiple publisher domains
A/B testing platforms rotating domains for conversion optimization
Advertising analytics platforms with standardized URL parameter schemas
